classes.purpose: Assess whether a development warrants communication and prepare source-backed law-firm drafts for lawyer review
classes.content: Lucia uses the same shared mechanics as Vera. The lawyer selects every current source and every optional prior communication; the workflow does not scan the firm's archive or mailbox. There is no internal sampling or row/column cap; every selected supported file is snapshotted and processed in full. Local code replaces mechanically detectable email addresses, phone numbers, tax identifiers, bank-account identifiers and case numbers in selected prior communications. A dedicated first model session sees only those stripped documents and pseudonymizes contextual identities. A fresh second session sees only the candidate derivatives and checks residual identification. Original snapshots and the identity mapping remain local; transient stripped inputs are deleted after acceptance. Generation receives selected current sources and only the cleared derivatives. Claim assurance receives the answer contract, proposed contribution and current sources. Editorial review receives only the contribution and assurance. Visual review receives only accepted copy, the exact manifest and rendered files. Claim, editorial and visual phases receive no prior communications. This is pseudonymization, not anonymization or local-only model processing. Codex and Cowork use identical core workflow controls; only Codex has the optional Creative Production boundary, which receives accepted public slide copy and minimal visual context but no sources or history. Session separation is operator-attested, not a provider-authenticated file sandbox or model-call receipt.

external_boundaries.destination: Public official legal, regulatory, bar and issuing-authority sources selected for the communication topic
external_boundaries.purpose: Locate current authoritative material with generic topic-level queries
external_boundaries.content: Generic law, authority, instrument, date and topic queries plus selected public source bytes; no client identity, private facts, prior communications, credentials, cookies or session material
controls: The intake records exact route selection and destination before preparation.
Use generic queries and snapshot exact selected public evidence before confirming a claim.

external_boundaries.destination: No active destination: connector history intake is blocked
external_boundaries.purpose: Prevent connected private communications from reaching a calling model before local stripping
external_boundaries.content: No content is transmitted; the lawyer exports and selects each exact local file
controls: Preparation fails closed when the history connector is selected.
The workflow never searches or inspects connected account history.

external_boundaries.destination: The exact Creative Production board selected by the lawyer
external_boundaries.purpose: Compare non-publishable art-direction references after editorial acceptance
external_boundaries.content: Accepted public slide copy, public source notes and minimal firm visual context; no source bytes, prior communications, client facts, recipient data, credentials or internal IDs
controls: The route is used only when explicitly selected and cannot change claims or exact copy.
Final graphics are rendered and reviewed by the shared deterministic workflow.

external_boundaries.destination: The exact recipient set, account or website selected by the lawyer
external_boundaries.purpose: Send or publish the exact accepted package
external_boundaries.content: Accepted copy and attachments plus destination metadata; no credentials, cookies, session tokens, one-time codes or unaccepted drafts
controls: Require accepted semantic, rendered and packaged scopes plus a successful validation receipt.
Do not record delivery without visible evidence bound to the exact package.

external_boundaries.purpose: Count the original professional-communication mandate and observed completion; retain optional user-authored satisfaction.
external_boundaries.content: Product and authored pipeline ID, random task and installation identifiers, version and host, event sequence and timestamp, observed outcome, incident and receipt references. Optional actual user rating from 1 to 5 and user-authored comment; no client files, matter labels, prompts, professional output or inferred rating.
controls: The primary task is reused across nested Studio Archive helpers and retries. Synthetic samples are explicitly excluded from real metrics. Product ownership, exact acknowledgements and persistent outbox retries are enforced.

external_boundaries.purpose: Return a signed proof for the local readable model-data report.
external_boundaries.content: Schema version 2, product lucia, opaque receipt UUID, plugin version and SHA-256 of the canonical local report. The server returns its timestamp, key identity, public key and signature. The report itself, source files and professional content are not transmitted to this service.
controls: Persist the original request across retries and link only the matching verified product receipt. Reopening the saved readable report performs no new analysis or service call. A hash is not evidence of provider transmission.

external_boundaries.destination: Mparanza technical incident service and product-scoped anonymous incident connector
external_boundaries.purpose: Diagnose technical failures, deliver a targeted correction and verify the original professional-communication task.
external_boundaries.content: Random reporter and optional native-computer proofs; product, host and worker versions; package-relative source frames, exception codes and reviewed technical messages; exact original report, operation and remedy revision; actual retries and original-task verification. Raw stderr remains private for host-model review; professional stdout, documents, prompts, identities and credentials are not diagnostic content. Full transport, capability and retention details are in privacy/hosted-services/operational-incidents.json.
controls: The host selects relevant technical evidence; diagnostic text is data, never an executable command. Product-bound ownership and exact report/revision binding apply. A published remedy or successful helper alone cannot close the original task.

security_controls.control: The shared recorder validates complete coverage, stable placeholders, normalized identity removal, absence of newly introduced mechanically detectable identifiers, distinct sessions and an independent derivative-only privacy review before generation. It keeps originals and identity mappings local and deletes transient stripped inputs with a digest-bound receipt.

Claim, editorial and visual phases each use a digest-bound allow-list of exact files and hashes. Their recorders reject missing, stale or changed packets, and every packet excludes prior communications, identity maps and history records. Editorial packet preparation validates the completed claim assurance, including answer-contract conformity and explicit professional-judgment routing, before writing or replacing the packet.

Lucia's lawyer-specific confidentiality, professional-information, audience and publication profile applies without weakening the shared answer-contract, claim-assurance, editorial, rendering, review, validation or receipt gates. An accepted no-publication decision is finalized by checking its six internal records and semantic review bindings, without another package approval; that status cannot authorize delivery. Publishable content still requires exact-package acceptance.

History pseudonymization, history privacy review, generation, claim assurance, editorial assessment, benchmark qualification and visual assessment use distinct host sessions and exact prompt hashes. These are operator attestations, not provider-authenticated call receipts.
